subject.title: fix(codex): remove duplicate provider setup choice

question: Does the migration-provider contract guarantee a dedicated setup path for every plugin it now excludes from the generic prompt, and does the Codex harness remain discoverable through all supported installation and migration flows?
rationale: The generic exclusion affects more than Codex, and repository policy requires direct sibling Codex source inspection before accepting this ownership change.

options.title: Approve after contract proof
options.body: Land after checking the Codex source contract and proving that each affected migration owner retains a discoverable dedicated setup path.

options.title: Narrow exclusion to Codex
options.body: Special-case the known Codex migration owner if the migration-provider contract does not universally imply a dedicated setup flow.

options.title: Retain generic prompt
options.body: Keep migration-owner plugins in the optional prompt if it remains a supported installation entry point for any affected plugin.

recommendation.title: Approve after contract proof
recommendation.body: Land after checking the Codex source contract and proving that each affected migration owner retains a discoverable dedicated setup path.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the revised implementation and are the strongest available owner for the catalog and setup-boundary decision.
